authorProcess: Claude Code session (Research Intelligence PHASE 2, STEP 14) — rule only; no observation file opened
onlyChangeFromPreviousRule: observationPeriod widened from calendar year 2015 to 2010-01-01 through 2020-12-31 (fixed at STEP 14 start, before any window scan); A1 now defined from the first observed hourly displacement instead of the provider velocity field, as specified in the STEP 14 instruction. Every threshold, region box, horizon and minimum is unchanged.

observationSource.provider: NOAA AOML GDP hourly QC (ERDDAP drifter_hourly_qc, CC BY 4.0)
observationSource.note: To be acquired only after this rule is committed; not opened in STEP 14

observationPeriod.fixedBefore: any window scan or observation download

windowDefinition: for every calendar day D in the observation period: START = D 12:00 UTC, END = START + 72 h; each region × day evaluated independently with observations only
regionsUnchangedFrom: cohort-selection-rule-v2 (identical boxes; none added, removed or resized)

E1.rule: drogue attached through the window end
E1.test: drogue_lost_date empty or later than END

E3.rule: 73 hourly observations in the window with consecutive gap <= 1 h
E3.test: samples present at START + k h for k = 0..72 and provider gap <= 3600 s for each

E4.rule: start point more than 100 km from the nearest Natural Earth 1:10m coastline

E5.rule: start point inside the candidate region box
E5.note: leaving the box during the window is NOT an exclusion

A1.name: start observed speed
A1.definition: speed_start = great-circle distance(position[t0], position[first valid observation after t0 permitted by E3]) / actual elapsed seconds; nominally the +1 h sample. No provider or model velocity is used.

A3.name: bearing change
A3.definition: minimum angular difference between bearing(position[t0] → position[t0+24 h]) and bearing(position[t0+24 h] → position[t0+72 h]); a leg shorter than 1 km has an undefined bearing and counts as 180° (conservative). No instantaneous-heading averaging.

qualifyingWindow: eligible_count >= 8 AND A1 PASS AND A2 PASS AND A3 PASS
windowSelectionWithinRegion: EARLIEST calendar qualifying window only; never the best, largest-displacement, largest-count or model-favourable window
regionSelectionOrder: eligible drifter count at the region's earliest qualifying window, descending
changePolicy: any change requires a new ruleId and a new preregistration commit; this rule is never edited in place
status: RULE_FIXED — no window scanned, no observation acquired
